description: This file defines the 'Marketing' model class within the OpenCart admin module. It contains methods to retrieve marketing campaign data and counts from the database, with filtering options based on date range and order status.
external_files: database connection or query execution class (db)

classes.name: Marketing
classes.description: A model class responsible for fetching marketing campaign data and total count from the database, used within OpenCart's admin reporting extension.

methods.name: getMarketing
methods.description: Retrieves a list of marketing campaigns with statistics such as clicks and orders, applying optional filters for date range and order status, with pagination support.

methods.name: getTotalMarketing
methods.description: Returns the total number of marketing campaign records in the database, with optional filtering reasons not shown explicitly in this method.
